title: Outfit Landing Page Reveal
description: Preloader reveal for a fashion-archive landing page: six stacked centered images with random tilts scale up and un-clip with stagger while a SplitText title animates in and a 000-to-100 counter ticks; everything then exits and the preloader clips away upward, revealing the hero with masked char/word slide-ups on the header, nav and footer. Plays automatically once on page load.

images.desc: moody editorial studio portrait of a woman in a deep oxblood dress and matching fur stole, dramatic side light on grey backdrop
black-and-white editorial fashion image of a model draped in sheer black mesh fabric, arms raised, grey studio backdrop
translucent blue-grey human figure curled in fetal position floating on a pale background, x-ray look
still life of purple iris flowers in a glass vase on a marble table against an oxblood red wall
black-and-white photo of the back of a woman's head with slicked wet hair in a low bun
macro close-up of pale yellow flower stamens against a soft lilac background, shallow depth of field

intent.useWhen: Úsalo cuando lances una landing de moda o archivo y quieras una intro a pantalla completa con contador y fotos apiladas antes de revelar el hero.
